description: This file defines the CameraCaptureService actor in Swift, providing camera and video capture functionalities, error handling, device management, and related helper classes for a macOS application.

classes.name: PhotoCaptureDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for handling photo capture callbacks, completes a continuation with image data or errors.

classes.name: MovieFileDelegate
classes.description: Delegate class for recording video files, manages completion or errors during recording.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Returns a list of available camera devices with details.

methods.name: snap
methods.description: Captures a photo with specified settings asynchronously.

methods.name: clip
methods.description: Records a video clip asynchronously, optionally including audio.

methods.name: ensureAccess
methods.description: Checks and requests camera or microphone permissions asynchronously.

methods.name: availableCameras
methods.description: Returns a list of available AVCaptureDevice objects.

methods.name: externalDeviceType
methods.description: Returns external camera device type depending on macOS version.

methods.name: pickCamera
methods.description: Selects a camera device based on facing direction and device ID.

methods.name: normalizeSnap
methods.description: Normalizes maxWidth and quality parameters for photo capture.

methods.name: exportToMP4
methods.description: Exports a video from input URL to output URL with MP4 format asynchronously.

methods.name: waitForExposureAndWhiteBalance
methods.description: Waits until camera exposure and white balance adjustments are complete.

methods.name: sleepDelayMs
methods.description: Pauses execution for specified millisecond delay asynchronously.
